PyPI rejected this release because no trusted publisher matches this workflow.

browser-commander does not exist on PyPI yet, so the per-project settings page does not exist either. Register a *pending* publisher instead: https://pypi.org/manage/account/publishing/

Fill the form with exactly these values:
  PyPI Project Name: browser-commander
  Owner: link-foundation
  Repository name: browser-commander
  Workflow name: python.yml
  Environment name: leave this empty   (the job declares no `environment:`, so the OIDC claim is MISSING; filling this in is the most common way to get an `invalid-publisher` that otherwise looks correct)

Then re-run this job. Nothing in this repository can complete this step; it needs a PyPI account with permission to register the name. More detail: https://docs.pypi.org/trusted-publishers/troubleshooting/

Trusted publishing exchange failure: 
Token request failed: the server refused the request for the following reasons:

* `invalid-publisher`: valid token, but no corresponding publisher (Publisher with matching claims was not found)

This generally indicates a trusted publisher configuration error, but could
also indicate an internal error on GitHub or PyPI's part.
